description: Compare a translation against its source document for structural drift: heading sequence, HTML tag sequence, table row count, internal link paths, price tokens, locale prefix on internal links, leftover source-script characters, introduced em dashes and emoji. This checks structure, not meaning: it cannot tell you a translation is good, only that it is no longer the same document.

forbid_source_script.description: Set false when the target legitimately shares the source script, e.g. Simplified Chinese from a Traditional Chinese source.

locale.description: Locale code of the translation, e.g. "es". Internal links are expected to carry it as a prefix.

require_front_matter.description: Require line 1 to be an H1 and line 2 to be a summary blockquote.

name: check_translation
